line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: Mayhem.Mission.Provision.Distribute
* DESCRIPTION: Distributes wares to the mission giver's assets.
* Factory resources are distributed to available factories owned by the mission giver. Leftovers are moved to the nearest safe Outpost.
* Products are distributed to the nearest safe Outpost.
* Ore and Teladianium are treated as factory resources before being moved to an Outpost.
* Missiles are evenly distributed to ships. Fox missiles are given to M8s first, then to other ships.
* AUTHOR: DATE: 3 October 2026
* Ore and Teladianium are products for crafting purposes, but are also consumed as factory resources.
* Factory resources
* Factory must use this ware as a primary resource.
* Do not interfere with a Trader currently servicing this ware.
* Reserve cargo space already claimed by inbound Traders.

line.text: 'PROVISION RESOURCE: factory=%s ware=%s usableFree=%s claimed=%s add=%s'

line.comment: * Products
* Missiles
* Only ships currently assigned to squadrons are eligible.
* Ship must be able to fire the missile.
* Randomize the ship array.
* Fox missiles prioritize M8s.
* Separate M8s from all other compatible squadron ships since they can fire missiles while OOS.
* Distribute evenly among M8s first.
* Any missiles that M8s cannot carry are distributed among other ships.
* Non-Fox missiles (artillery missiles and Chaff) have no M8 priority.
* Anything the fleet cannot carry is sent to an Outpost for recycling.
* Move products, remaining resources, or remaining missiles to the nearest safe Outpost.
* Should never happen.
* Keep only existing ships that can currently carry at least one missile.
* Use the filtered array without modifying the original ship array.
* No usable ships remain.
* Give every ship the same target share during this pass.
* Never distribute more than remains.

line.text: 'PROVISION MISSILE ADD: ship=%s ware=%s share=%s capacity=%s add=%s'
